criteria.criterion: A Compose service URL rewrites to the published host port when that port is remapped, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k host_url_uses_the_published_port_when_remapped`
A Compose service URL keeps its port when no remap is configured, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k host_url_keeps_the_default_port_when_unmapped`
A rewritten URL preserves user credentials, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k host_url_preserves_credentials_across_the_port_remap`
A Compose host:port value rewrites to the published host port when remapped, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k host_hostport_uses_the_published_port_when_remapped`
A non-Compose hostname is returned unchanged, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k host_url_leaves_a_foreign_hostname_alone`
The rewrite stays inert inside the platform image, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k host_url_is_inert_inside_the_platform_image`

Every Compose service that the rewrite recognises publishes its port through a variable, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k every_rewritable_service_publishes_through_a_variable`
The migration URL follows the published Postgres port, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k alembic_database_url_follows_the_published_postgres_port`

A configured migration URL naming the Compose service is rewritten for the host, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k alembic_database_url_rewrites_a_configured_service_address`
The collector's three published ports map independently of one another, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k otel_collector_maps_each_of_its_three_ports_separately`
A bare Compose service name with no port rewrites to a bare localhost, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k host_hostport_returns_a_bare_service_name_without_a_port`
A Compose service URL with no port keeps its portless form, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_config_host_rewrite.py -k host_url_without_a_port_gains_none`
Bug 'Rewrite Compose service URLs to the published host port rather than the internal port' is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces and expected behavior holds.
